def load_unverified_project_from_config(project_root: Path
    ) ->UnverifiedProjectModel:
    config = configparser.ConfigParser()
    config_file_path = project_root / PROJECT_CONFIG
    config.read(config_file_path)

    project_id = None
    project_url = None
    project_name = None

    if PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION in config:
        project_id = config[PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION].get(PROJECT_CONFIG_ID)
        project_url = config[PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION].get(PROJECT_CONFIG_URL)
        project_name = config[PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION].get(PROJECT_CONFIG_NAME)

    return UnverifiedProjectModel(
        id=project_id,
        url_path=project_url,
        name=project_name
    )
